crossRefs.note: He said, “My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he only is left. If harm happens to him along…

translations.web: Take your brother also, get up, and return to the man.
translations.bsb: Take your brother as well, and return to the man at once.
translations.kjv: Take also your brother, and arise, go again unto the man:
translations.asv: take also your brother, and arise, go again unto the man:
